_about: Real raw ConPTY output (Windows 11, PS 5.1 host) of Claude Code 2.1.304 showing its reply when a usage limit stops it ("You've hit your session limit · resets 8:10pm (America/New_York)"), where no rate-limit menu opens (Max 20x, an API key, a Team plan). Made by the minors reviews of fix/swarm154 (M-0, M-2, M1-1): a session whose records copy those of a real limit hit, resumed by the real claude with no prompt sent, so no model was used. Under the reply Claude Code draws the hint for the account and then, as at the end of every turn, its line with how long the turn took ('✻ Crunched for 0s · done 1:21 AM'), which a narrow screen wraps onto a second row. Each capture's raw output is kept once; each of its screens is the output up to `at`, drawn at `cols` x `rows` (the PTY was resized between them). The user name is replaced letter for letter wherever the screen draws it, across a row break, an escape sequence or a redraw, so every row lays out as it did.

reply-done.shows: the reply under the prompt it stopped, the line at the turn's end under it

reply-done-narrow.shows: the same, made 30 and then 20 columns wide

midturn-done.shows: the reply under the output of the tool it ran, mid-turn, the line at the turn's end under it

task-done.shows: the reply under a task of 1,480 characters in three paragraphs, its first rows gone off the top, the line at the turn's end under it
